conf.description: Veritas NetBackup audit, syslog-raw (native text), direct route. Hand-built parse per recommendations.direct.cribl: user split, action lowercase, outcome derived from DESCRIPTION for LOGIN/DATAACCESS, _time from TIMESTAMP; delimiter grammar and masking are documented assumptions/gaps (see README)

conf.comment: NetBackup nbaudit native-text audit events, direct route. ASSUMED pipe-delimited TIMESTAMP|USER|CATEGORY|ACTION|DESCRIPTION|REASON|DETAILS|OLD VALUE|NEW VALUE body (no live sample provided in the work order; verify against a real primary before deploy). Converges on the same target schema as the OCSF and api-pull audit pipelines.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, format and delimiter assumption
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Positional extract of the pipe-delimited audit body, tolerating an optional leading nbaudit syslog tag
Batch rename of directly-mapped fields with no transform (host assumed populated by the Cribl Syslog Source)
process.name constant, USER split on final '@', ACTION lowercased, CATEGORY/DETAILS/OLD VALUE/NEW VALUE to custom namespace
Best-effort event.outcome for LOGIN/DATAACCESS by substring match on DESCRIPTION prose (no confirmed phrasing sample; see README gap)
Event time from TIMESTAMP (assumed epoch seconds UTC) into _time, not @timestamp (platform constraint)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
